item.title: Ukraine’s Zelenskyy set to meet Trump as Iran and Ukraine wars converge
item.description: The US Senate will vote Tuesday on Russian sanctions, days after Ukraine attacked an Iranian vessel in the Caspian Sea.

item.title: US warns hundreds of Boeing jets may require seat safety inspections
item.description: US regulator warns of Boeing 737 MAX seat safety concerns, calls for inspection of 453 US-registered jets.

item.title: Trump says Iran talks taking place during pause in US military strikes
item.description: US President Donald Trump says talks with Iran are continuing during a pause in US military strikes

item.title: Ebola response workers strike in DR Congo as death toll spikes
item.description: Healthcare workers at an Ebola treatment centre in Bunia, Democratic Republic of Congo, have gone on strike.

item.title: How telehealth is helping close the healthcare gap in rural Zimbabwe
item.description: Virtual consultations are replacing hours of travel, bringing affordable healthcare closer to rural Zimbabweans.

item.title: Former senior ICE official says rush for numbers is causing deaths
item.description: Fmr. Acting Chief of Staff at ICE: a rush to hire officers and a focus on detention numbers is causing fatal mistakes.

item.title: Johnson & Johnson offers $5.5bn to settle talc cancer lawsuits
item.description: Johnson & Johnson agrees to pay $5.5bn to settle nearly 70,000 US lawsuits over talc-based baby powder cancer claims.

item.title: Houthis want to copy Iran’s Hormuz control in the Red Sea: Yemeni FM
item.description: Speaking in Riyadh, Yemen's internationally recognised government warns global complacency has emboldened the Houthis.

item.title: Savannah Guthrie pleads for help to find missing mother
item.description: Journalist Savannah Guthrie has made an emotional public appeal for information about her missing mother.

item.title: Trump on Erdogan, Netanyahu and selling fighter jets to Turkiye
item.description: US President Donald Trump called Turkiye 'a great ally' when asked about selling F-35 fighter jets to Ankara.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump says ‘friendly’ talks ongoing; Netanyahu arrives in US
item.description: Iran says US 'struggling' to end five-month-old war, as Netanyahu arrives in Washington, DC, for talks with Trump.

item.title: US diplomats walk out as France addresses UN Security Council
item.description: US diplomats walk out of UN meeting during France's speech amid tensions over human rights chief's reappointment.

item.title: Shot fired outside US consulate in Toronto for second time this year
item.description: Canadian police have said youth are being recruited via encrypted messaging to carry out shootings in the Toronto area.

item.title: Video shows man subdued after stabbing three women in Paris
item.description: Three women were wounded, two of them seriously, in a knife attack near Porte de Clichy in Paris.

item.title: Trump asks US Supreme Court to allow mail-in voting restrictions
item.description: A lower court blocked the mail-in ballot restrictions, ruling Trump lacked authority to change state election rules.

item.title: UN slams Israel’s expansion of illegal settlements in occupied West Bank
item.description: UN chief Guterres says settlements a 'flagrant violation' of international law, amid escalating violence.

item.title: Nvidia plans $250bn push to bolster OpenAI’s infrastructure ambitions
item.description: Political backlash grows as US states propose bans on new data centres, raising challenges for Nvidia and AI industry.

item.title: Hopes of return to diplomacy as US-Iran hold fire for third day
item.description: Mediators from Qatar and Pakistan work to restart ceasefire talks amid fragile pause in hostilities.

item.title: Will Peru’s new leader Keiko Fujimori reject her father’s legacy?
item.description: Keiko Fujimori was elected president and many people are sceptical she will be able to unite Peru as promised.

item.title: UK court dismisses Bahrain’s bid to block activists’ spyware lawsuit
item.description: Ruling establishes that countries using spyware on people in the UK can be sued.

item.title: Hakeem Jeffries puts affordability at centre of Democrats’ midterm campaign
item.description: US House Democratic leader unveils 'Fighting for an Affordable America' agenda, blaming Donald Trump for rising costs.

item.title: Trump takes economic message to Michigan amid dwindling popularity
item.description: US president is suffering from low approval ratings in state that has become 'ground zero' for his trade policies.

item.title: Has Burnham kept his promise to do better on Israel’s war on Gaza?
item.description: Will Britain's new cabinet change the country’s role in Israel’s war on Gaza?

item.title: Unreleased footage reveals Lindsey Graham’s push for war on Iran
item.description: Unreleased documentary footage shows late US Senator Lindsey Graham celebrating the war on Iran.

item.title: Spain protests mass ‘touristification’ of Mallorca
item.description: Thousands of protesters filled the streets of Palma to denounce mass tourism.
